findings.title: The path argument is not quoted in the documented safe-write command, so a draft path containing a space or an apostrophe breaks the command.
findings.evidence: .claude/agents/idea-planner.md:146 (`... " docs/00-working/promoted/<reserved-code>-<slug>.md`, no quotes around the trailing path). Reproduced with `PLAN-042-my plan's file.md` via bash -c: `bash: -c: line 6: unexpected EOF while looking for matching '''` (rc=2).
findings.consequence: Low-risk in practice — ADR-019 and every existing code-prefixed filename use kebab-case slugs with no spaces or quote characters, though nothing in src/governance/ or tools/ enforces that charset — so it is a latent gap, not an active one.
